sources.title: lcm-ssd-1b: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview lcm-ssd-1b is a Latent Consistency Model distilled from the SSD-1B base architecture that generates images from text prompts with only 2 to 8 inference steps instead of the 20-50 steps typical diffusion models require. Developed by latent-consistency, this checkpoint replaces the standard UNet2DConditionModel with a consistency-distilled variant while maintaining compatibility with ...

sources.title: Image generation with Segmind Stable Diffusion 1B (SSD-1B) model and ...
sources.snippet: Latent Consistency Model (LCM) was proposed in Latent Consistency Models: Synthesizing High-Resolution Images with Few-Step Inference and was successfully applied the same approach to create LCM for SDXL. This checkpoint is a LCM distilled version of segmind/SSD-1B that allows to reduce the number of inference steps to only between 2 - 8 steps.
